patterns.note: Content is presented in a single, centered column with generous vertical spacing between major sections, creating an airy and uncluttered feel.
A clear typographic hierarchy is established using bold, sans-serif headings for section titles and a consistent dark grey for body text, with all interactive links rendered in a distinct blue.
The design uses a minimal color palette dominated by white and very light blue backgrounds, dark grey text, and a consistent blue for all interactive elements and calls to action.
No scroll-triggered motion is observed; content simply scrolls vertically without any reveal animations, parallax effects, or sticky elements, maintaining a static presentation.
Informational content is organized into distinct, self-contained sections, each introduced by a bold heading and often featuring a grid layout of icon-and-text links for projects and resources.

technique_notes: The site employs a straightforward, static layout where content is contained within a centered column. Visual separation between content blocks is achieved through ample vertical padding and subtle background color changes, such as a light blue tint for the donation call-to-action section. Interactive elements like project links are presented in a simple grid with an icon positioned above descriptive text. The user experience relies entirely on standard browser scrolling, with no custom scroll-triggered animations, transitions, or sticky components implemented.

design_tokens.type_scale: Clear hierarchy with bold, medium-sized headings (~1.5-2x body) and standard body text, featuring a larger, bolder hero statement (~2.5x body).
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, with no visible rounded elements except for the subtle rounding on the CTA button.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and balanced spacing within content blocks, creating a clean and uncluttered feel.

standout: The design stands out for its extreme simplicity and unwavering focus on content, deliberately avoiding modern visual flourishes like complex animations or rich graphics. It leverages a highly minimal color palette and a straightforward, centered layout, which imbues it with an authoritative and highly accessible feel, prioritizing information dissemination over contemporary aesthetic trends.
